battle_master_maneuvers.name: Commander's Strike
battle_master_maneuvers.description: When you take the Attack action, you can forgo one attack and use a bonus action to direct an ally to strike.

battle_master_maneuvers.name: Disarming Attack
battle_master_maneuvers.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend a superiority die to attempt to disarm the target.

battle_master_maneuvers.name: Distracting Strike
battle_master_maneuvers.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend a superiority die to distract the creature.

battle_master_maneuvers.name: Evasive Footwork
battle_master_maneuvers.description: When you move, you can expend a superiority die and add the roll to your AC until you stop moving.

battle_master_maneuvers.name: Feinting Attack
battle_master_maneuvers.description: You can expend a superiority die and use a bonus action to feint, gaining advantage on your next attack against a creature.

battle_master_maneuvers.name: Goading Attack
battle_master_maneuvers.description: When you hit with a weapon attack, you can expend a superiority die to goad the target into attacking you.

battle_master_maneuvers.name: Lunging Attack
battle_master_maneuvers.description: When you make a melee weapon attack, you can expend a superiority die to increase your reach for that attack.

battle_master_maneuvers.name: Maneuvering Attack
battle_master_maneuvers.description: When you hit with a weapon attack, you can expend a superiority die to let an ally move without provoking from the target.

battle_master_maneuvers.name: Menacing Attack
battle_master_maneuvers.description: When you hit with a weapon attack, you can expend a superiority die to attempt to frighten the target.

battle_master_maneuvers.name: Parry
battle_master_maneuvers.description: When another creature damages you with a melee attack, you can expend a superiority die to reduce the damage.

battle_master_maneuvers.name: Precision Attack
battle_master_maneuvers.description: When you make a weapon attack roll, you can expend a superiority die and add it to the roll.

battle_master_maneuvers.name: Pushing Attack
battle_master_maneuvers.description: When you hit with a weapon attack, you can expend a superiority die to attempt to push the target away.

battle_master_maneuvers.name: Rally
battle_master_maneuvers.description: On your turn, you can expend a superiority die and use a bonus action to bolster an ally with temporary hit points.

battle_master_maneuvers.name: Riposte
battle_master_maneuvers.description: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you can expend a superiority die to make a melee weapon attack against it.

battle_master_maneuvers.name: Sweeping Attack
battle_master_maneuvers.description: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, you can expend a superiority die to damage another creature within reach.

battle_master_maneuvers.name: Trip Attack
battle_master_maneuvers.description: When you hit with a weapon attack, you can expend a superiority die to attempt to knock the target prone.

fighting_styles_fighter.name: Dueling

fighting_styles_fighter.name: Great Weapon Fighting
fighting_styles_fighter.description: Reroll very low damage dice when you use a two-handed or versatile melee weapon with two hands.

fighting_styles_fighter.name: Protection
fighting_styles_fighter.description: Use your shield and reaction to impose disadvantage on an attack against a nearby ally.

fighting_styles_fighter.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
fighting_styles_fighter.description: Add your ability modifier to the damage of your second weapon attack when fighting with two weapons.

metamagic_options.name: Careful Spell
metamagic_options.description: Protect chosen creatures from the worst effects of your spell by helping them succeed on the saving throw.

metamagic_options.name: Distant Spell
metamagic_options.description: Increase a spell's range, or make a touch spell reach farther.

metamagic_options.name: Empowered Spell
metamagic_options.description: Reroll some of a spell's damage dice after you roll damage.

metamagic_options.name: Extended Spell
metamagic_options.description: Double a spell's duration, up to a maximum of 24 hours.

metamagic_options.name: Heightened Spell
metamagic_options.description: Give one target disadvantage on its first saving throw against the spell.

metamagic_options.name: Quickened Spell
metamagic_options.description: Cast a spell that normally takes an action as a bonus action instead.

metamagic_options.name: Subtle Spell
metamagic_options.description: Cast a spell without somatic or verbal components.

metamagic_options.name: Twinned Spell
metamagic_options.description: Make a single-target spell affect a second valid target.
